entry: SliceClip.init(opts)  // opts all optional; defaults drive the frs7 DOM ids. The one knob that makes the 3 prototypes is dir: 'lr'|'td'|'bu'
rules: the render swaps via a CLEAN clip-path inset wipe, NEVER an opacity crossfade or video.currentTime
TWO stacked layers, BOTH opacity:1 the whole time (outgoing zIndex 1 underneath, incoming zIndex 2 revealed by the clip inset) => zero ghosting, zero double-exposure
outside the short wipe window exactly ONE photo fills the frame (media centre is always a photo, no blank, no cover-plate)
frs3 composition: numbered spec-rail LEFT 38%, BIG contained fixed-size render RIGHT 62%, ~2cm gap, bronze #c08a4e accent
ONE smoother: Lenis 1.1.13 lerp 0.1 smoothWheel -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0)
render(prog) is a PURE fn driven from onUpdate + once at init; pin/pinSpacing/scrub:true
the wipe holds the current photo ~hold of the beat then wipes the last (1-hold) on a gentle glide ease (0.45,0.05,0.2,1), NOT the snappy air
display = Fraunces serif; rail + meta = Inter
transform / opacity / clip-path ONLY — no WebGL, no mask-composite, no mix-blend / backdrop over the scrubbed surface, no video.currentTime

the bronze edge-line is kept ONLY for dir=lr (it rides the clip seam); dir=td and dir=bu ship edge:false because there the edge travelled OPPOSITE the wipe (a stray line from the wrong side) and was removed on purpose
reduced-motion / <=820px => static readable stack (no Lenis, no pin, no scrub)

dir.meaning: clip wipe direction (the inset axis): lr = left->right (base frs7) | td = top->down (frs8) | bu = bottom->up (frs10)

edge.default: null->true for lr, false for td/bu
edge.meaning: show the bronze edge-line riding the clip seam; default keeps it ONLY for lr (the base); td/bu set false on purpose (the edge travelled opposite the wipe = a bug)

slides.meaning: the beats [{src,tag,idx,name,title,sub,objPos}]; else the faithful frs7 6-render deck (DEFAULT_SLIDES)

dwell.meaning: fraction of scroll progress over which the whole deck advances (the rest is end breathing room)

hold.meaning: fraction of EACH beat the current photo is held still before the wipe (wipe takes the last 1-hold)

pinFactor.meaning: pin scroll length = innerHeight * (slides-1) * pinFactor (higher = calmer)

lerp.meaning: Lenis smoothing of the scrubbed scroll

ease_wipe.meaning: the gentle ease-in-out the clip seam travels on (softer than the air ease so the edge starts/ends smoothly)

ease_rail.meaning: the ease the rail marker glides between rows on

accent.meaning: the bronze accent (edge-line, active row, marker, progress fill)
